summary.text: Paul Takac is a Democratic member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from District 82, which he has represented since December 2022, and he is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
Before his election he worked for Apple as an account executive and region manager for K-12 and higher education, and he served on the College Township Council.

paragraphs.text: Takac lives in Happy Valley, Pennsylvania, and graduated from Orchard Park High School in New York in 1983.

He earned a B.A., cum laude, in anthropology from the State University of New York at Buffalo in 1987, an M.A. in archaeology/anthropology from Southern Methodist University in 1991, and an M.S. in nutrition and integrative health from the Maryland University of Integrative Health in 2018.
Takac chaired the Spring Creek Watershed Commission and the Centre Region Council of Governments' public safety committee.

In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the House Agriculture & Rural Affairs, Environmental Resources & Energy, and Veterans Affairs & Emergency Preparedness committees, the Committee on Committees, and the Tourism & Recreational Development Committee, where he chaired its Recreation subcommittee.
